data.plain_english: A US article noted that Coca-Cola's shares have tended to hold up when the broader US market falls. That fits a wider worry, because US borrowing costs have climbed to their highest levels in many years. The council thinks US banks and Hong Kong and Chinese technology companies are more likely to struggle. It sees Chinese banks and energy companies as roughly steady. The council is most divided on US technology companies, which have risen strongly but could be hurt by higher interest rates. This is research only, not advice to buy or sell anything.
